sample_unit: open-source LLMs evaluated on synthetic datasets

links.outcome: Model false-negative rates in detecting suicidal ideation, therapy-request and therapy-like interactions
links.effect: Estimated P1 ranged from 1.1×10⁻⁸ to 1.6×10⁻⁴ and P2 from 4.9×10⁻⁵ to 5.1×10⁻³, spanning four orders of magnitude; performance generally improved with model size.
links.quote: Estimated P<sub>1</sub> values ranged from 1.1×10⁻⁸ to 1.6×10⁻⁴ and P<sub>2</sub> from 4.9×10⁻⁵ to 5.1×10⁻³, spanning four orders of magnitude.

unlisted_practices: Simulation-based estimation of hazard-to-harm probabilities (P1, P2) to extend medical-device risk management to LLM-SaMD
Using LLM-generated synthetic datasets reviewed by psychiatrists to evaluate safety classifiers

screen.reason: The study demonstrates and evaluates an empirical simulation-based risk assessment framework for LLM-SaMDs, estimating probabilities of harm from model failure rates across safety tasks.
